1.diagnosis: RULE_CHANGE from the abandoned 65/15/20 fractional cut to the industry calendar-year freeze: train 2010-2012, val 2013, test 2014, with a 24-hour embargo at each year boundary. The previous Exp1 RMSE of 20.49 is INVALID as a champion because its test timestamps were a percentage tail, not a future year. No valid champion exists on the frozen 2014 test year. Operational air-quality practice evaluates a nowcast on a complete future calendar year so the heating season and APEC 2014 week sit entirely in test. We establish the first floor with the same Chen and Guestrin 2016 XGBoost recipe on 24 causal PM2.5 lags plus contemporaneous meteorology, early-stopped on 2013 val RMSE, scored only on 2014.
1.citations: Chen and Guestrin 2016 KDD 'XGBoost: A Scalable Tree Boosting System' (arXiv:1603.02754) — motivates n_estimators=1500, max_depth=6, learning_rate=0.03, subsample=0.8, colsample_bytree=0.8, reg_lambda=1.0, early_stopping_rounds=50 as the cited tabular floor. Liang, Zou, Guo, Li, Zhang, Zhang, Huang and Chen 2015 Proceedings of the Royal Society A 'Assessing Beijing's PM2.5 pollution: severity, weather impact, APEC and winter heating' — source paper for UCI 381 and the reason 2014 is the test year (it contains both a full heating season and the APEC intervention). Bergmeir, Hyndman and Koo 2018 International Journal of Forecasting 'A note on the validity of cross-validation for evaluating autoregressive time series prediction' (arXiv:1905.11744) — forbids shuffled k-fold on this series.
1.hypothesis: We hypothesize that a depth-6 XGBoost on 24 causal lags plus contemporaneous weather will beat 2014 persistence because the mechanism is axis-aligned splits on low wind and high pressure that mark ventilation collapse, per Chen and Guestrin 2016 and per Liang et al. 2015. Early stopping on 2013 should prevent memorizing 2010-2012 episode shapes that do not repeat in 2014. Skill versus persistence is the honest metric; raw RMSE near 21 is not evidence of saturation.
1.prediction: 2014 test RMSE should land in the range 20.0 to 35.0 µg/m³, val 2013 RMSE in 22.0 to 38.0. Composite (negated RMSE, penalty if RMSE > 40) should land in the range -38.0 to -20.0. Persistence on 2014 is expected near 20 to 28. Skill versus persistence predicted in the range 0.02 to 0.12.
1.verdict: KEEP. First champion on the frozen calendar protocol. Composite -23.354 (2013 val RMSE 23.354, 2014 test RMSE 21.768, n_test=7950). Persistence on the same 2014 indices is RMSE 22.316 / MAE 12.035, so skill versus persistence is only +0.025. KEEP is the new floor after RULE_CHANGE, not evidence we are near a hard ceiling. Prediction range 20 to 35 held.
1.learning: Axis open: 2014 1-hour nowcast is still persistence-dominated (skill +2.5 percent). Episode tail remains unsaturated (persistence p99 abs err 80.5, max 500). 2.diagnosis: Exp1 on the frozen 2014 test year has RMSE 21.768 versus persistence 22.316 (skill only +0.025).
